purpose: Design input for evidence-backed visual and structural reverse engineering

analysis.evidenceMethod: qualitative review of 11 representative frames sampled across the clip

observations.description: A dark green and black interface presents a clone workflow in stages: observe, repair, clean room, diff, and parity.
The target appears to be an After Effects project. The workflow inspects the visible application and its UI structure, including windows, panels, timeline, and layers.
The interface presents a target-versus-clone comparison and a visual parity score.

designImplications: Separate observation, structural mapping, reconstruction, and comparison into visible steps.
Keep each claim linked to its source: screenshot, DOM/UI tree, runtime probe, or test result.
Show unknown or untested states explicitly and make comparison criteria inspectable.
